c1 | A clear daytime sky looks blue to people. | NASA Space Place, Why is the sky blue? | 3 | full text | consensus
c2 | Air molecules scatter shorter wavelengths much more strongly than longer ones (Rayleigh scattering). | Encyclopaedia Britannica, Rayleigh scattering | 3 | full text | consensus

c4 | At sunset light passes through roughly forty times more atmosphere than at noon, scattering out blue and leaving red. | Encyclopaedia Britannica, Rayleigh scattering | 3 | full text | consensus
